subject: change grey scale on bar plot

messages.author: 0141b24755b40cf8
messages.subject: change grey scale on bar plot
parts:
Hi all,

I am trying to create a simple bar plot with error bars, but am having
trouble making the barplots a lighter grey so that the error bars are
more visible. Here is an example.

Temp<-c("H","L","M")
avg<-c(63.8,47.3,58.6)
sd<-c(2.8,2.7,3.3)
dat.temp<-data.frame(cbind(Temp,as.numeric(as.character
(avg)),as.numeric(as.character(sd))))
#colnames(dat.temp)<-c("Temp","avg","sd")
rate.plot<-qplot(Temp,avg,data=dat.temp,geom="bar",position="dodge")
dodge <- position_dodge(width=0.9)
rate.plot+geom_linerange(aes(ymax=avg+sd, ymin=avg-sd), position=dodge)
+scale_fill_grey(start=.1,end=0.4)+theme_bw()

I assumed that scale_fill_grey() would be used to change the lightness
or darkness of the grey, but I am wrong.

Any hints how to do this?

Thanks,

Wade

messages.author: 4ddc99c6029ba75d
messages.subject: Re: change grey scale on bar plot
parts:
rate.plot<-qplot(Temp,avg,data=dat.temp,geom="bar",position="dodge",fill=I('grey60'))
dodge <- position_dodge(width=0.9)
rate.plot + geom_linerange(aes(ymax=avg+sd, ymin=avg-sd), position=dodge)


Felipe D. Carrillo
Supervisory Fishery Biologist
Department of the Interior
US Fish & Wildlife Service
California, USA
